fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized hover centuries mount their troops in hovercraft that provide the fastest ground transport available to Marian infantry, capable of crossing water obstacles and open ground at speeds that wheeled or tracked vehicles cannot match. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these formations field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
